_README: Salt-name synonyms. Hand-curated reference data, NOT generated.
Format: canonical name -> list of variant spellings. All lowercase.
These are used to EXPAND A QUERY ONLY. Reference rows always keep their
original spelling and are never merged or rewritten. Matching is two-tier:
exact spelling first, synonym-expanded only if tier 1 finds nothing.
ADMISSION RULE: a pair belongs here only if the two names denote the SAME
active moiety at the SAME strength basis. A salt and its free acid do NOT
qualify -- sodium valproate 200mg is not valproic acid 200mg, and treating
them as equal would corrupt every strength comparison. When unsure, leave
it out. A missing synonym costs coverage; a wrong one costs correctness.
